findings: A committed context map cannot safely define currentness by embedding its own checkout HEAD because committing the map changes HEAD.
The repaired design separates Git baseline provenance from current source-set truth.
baseline_revision is historical provenance and must be an ancestor of the validated checkout HEAD.
source_revision is SHA-256 over sorted canonical source id/path/blob tuples.
Every declared canonical source blob is verified against the actual checkout HEAD.
Context Resolver and compiled Context Capsules preserve both baseline_revision and source_revision.
The historical Context Resolver implementation receipt remains immutable history and no longer pins current project truth.

exact_head_evidence.includes: WPF build + ContextValidation + GatewayValidation + CapabilityModelValidation + reference render

reopen_triggers: canonical source-set membership changes without map refresh
declared source blob differs from actual HEAD
baseline is no longer ancestor of checkout HEAD
context map reintroduces fixed implementation SHA as current truth
